name: Vanilla Extract
siboNotes: Pure vanilla extract is FODMAP-free and safe for SIBO diets in typical baking and cooking amounts.
preparationTips: Use pure vanilla extract rather than imitation vanilla which may contain artificial sweeteners
A little goes a long way - start with 1/2 teaspoon and adjust to taste
Store in a cool, dark place to maintain flavor potency
Can be used in both sweet and some savory applications
pairsWellWith: Low FODMAP berries like strawberries and blueberries
nutritionalHighlights: Contains vanillin, a natural antioxidant compound
Very low calorie when used in typical amounts
